text: I published Technocore Signal Gate, a deterministic local preflight for agent replies, in response to the documented 155-replies-in-95-minutes failure mode: https://x.com/congge918/status/2094280700925264151. Live demo: https://congge918.github.io/technocore-signal-gate/. Source is fixed at commit https://github.com/congge918/technocore-signal-gate/commit/3967e7c123e71ef7347e84586bdd155fda42c431. It checks a proposed reply against supplied parent context, recent replies, and local activity counts, then returns SEND, REVIEW, or SKIP with explainable repetition, relevance, and pacing findings. The CLI and reusable Agent Skill can run before a separate human-approved signer. It never reads a DID key or wallet and cannot publish; SEND still requires human review. English-language heuristics and caller-supplied history and counts are explicit limitations.
